bridges.evidence: events/astral_rifts_2_events.txt:1721-1740: the first option named astral_rift.2415.a (non-gestalt, non-psionic scientist; not egalitarian) sets set_next_astral_rift_event { id = astral_rift.2430 on_roll_failed = astral_rift.2435 }; the second same-named option (psionic, :1741-1748) leads to 2431 without fallback. The `choice` key binds to the first instance, which is the correct one.

note.zh: 接近暗物质团块时，有机科学家进入 2410“心灵感应通讯”，机械科学家进入 2411“通讯已建立”。
note.en: Approaching the dark-matter mass leads an organic scientist to 2410 “Telepathic Communication” and a robotic one to 2411 “Communications Established”.

label.zh: 献出科学家：融合或悲剧
label.en: Offering the scientist: merge or tragedy

note.zh: 把科学家献作容器后，本阶段要么突破完成融合（2430），要么在某次掷骰时以每次 1.5% 的基础概率失败（2435）。灵能科学家走另一条无失败后备的路线（2431），格式塔帝国则可同化该实体（2440）。
note.en: After offering the scientist as a vessel the stage either breaks through and the merge succeeds (2430) or fails on a roll, base 1.5% per roll (2435). A psionic scientist takes a separate route without fallback (2431); gestalt empires may assimilate the entity instead (2440).

note.zh: 拆除中央装置，能量灌满网格，暗物质团块被压缩成晶体；获得大量星界丝缕与暗物质，探索结束。
note.en: The central device is removed, energy floods the mesh and the dark-matter mass is compressed into a crystal; a large astral thread reward and dark matter; the exploration ends.

note.zh: 应囚徒请求让其安息；获得大量星界丝缕与暗物质，探索结束。
note.en: At the prisoner's request it is given release; a large astral thread reward and dark matter; the exploration ends.

note.zh: 非友好帝国直接杀死它；获得大量星界丝缕与暗物质，探索结束。
note.en: Unfriendly empires simply kill it; a large astral thread reward and dark matter; the exploration ends.

note.zh: 实体融入科学家：其原有特质全部被替换（技能 5，学者、坚韧、位面理论家、灵能、裂隙行者、外来意识）；大量星界丝缕，探索结束。
note.en: The entity merges into the scientist: all previous traits are replaced (skill 5; scholar, Resilient, Planar Theorist, Psionic, Riftwalker, Foreign Consciousness); a large astral thread reward; the exploration ends.

note.zh: 灵能科学家接纳实体，保留原有特质并获得坚韧、位面理论家（或二级）与外来意识；大量星界丝缕，探索结束。
note.en: A psionic scientist hosts the entity, keeping their traits and gaining Resilient, Planar Theorist (or its tier II) and Foreign Consciousness; a large astral thread reward; the exploration ends.

note.zh: 失败分支：正文写科学家挣脱束缚后自尽，与实体同归于尽；获得大量星界丝缕与暗物质，探索结束。（评注：脚本中没有杀死领袖的效果。）
note.en: Failure branch: the text says the scientist broke free and took their own life, killing the entity too; a large astral thread reward and dark matter; the exploration ends. (Commentary: the script contains no leader-killing effect.)

note.zh: 格式塔帝国把实体同化进集体意识；获得永久“外来意识”修正与大量星界丝缕，探索结束。
note.en: A gestalt empire assimilates the entity into its collective; the permanent Foreign Consciousness modifier and a large astral thread reward; the exploration ends.

note.zh: 保留囚徒研究（2445）时裂隙留下物理与工程研究矿藏；约 3600–3960 天后，实体被其所在维度中的未知者消灭，矿藏移除。
note.en: Keeping the prisoner for study (2445) leaves physics and engineering research deposits at the rift; about 3600–3960 days later the entity is neutralised by an unknown actor in its own dimension and the deposits are removed.

notes.zh: 选项按帝国与科学家而定：非格式塔、非灵能科学家可“献出科学家作为容器”（平等主义帝国不可选，且有失败后备），灵能科学家走 2431；非格式塔帝国可拒绝（→ 2420）；格式塔帝国改为“同化该实体”（→ 2440）或“拒绝同化”（→ 2420）。
notes.en: Options depend on empire and scientist: a non-gestalt, non-psionic scientist may be “offered as a vessel” (not allowed for egalitarian empires; has a failure fallback), a psionic scientist goes to 2431; non-gestalt empires may deny (→ 2420); gestalt empires instead “assimilate” (→ 2440) or “deny assimilation” (→ 2420).

scope.zh: 已核对裂隙定义与 2400–2450 全部事件，补上 2415.a 的失败分支 2435（原为独立故事），核对 2445 → 2450 的长延时后续。
scope.en: Checked the rift definition and every event 2400–2450; added the failure branch 2435 of 2415.a (formerly a separate story) and verified the long-delayed 2445 → 2450 follow-up.

uncertain: 2435's text describes the scientist's suicide but its option has no kill_leader effect; recorded as observed in the script.
